Harmontide · a field guide to an inhabited world · volume XXVI · the bat family

Bats

Night fliers on leathery wings. By day they hang upside down from cave ceilings; by night they hear the whole world around them.

Favourite food: Fruit (apples, melon, berries)

The central similarity

Hanging upside down.

A bat rests hanging from a ceiling by her feet, wings wrapped round her, and flies at night.

  • RoostShe hangs from cave ceilings to rest.
  • EcholocationBefriended, she shows you the mobs near you, through walls.
  • NightAwake at night.
  • KinVanilla bats.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all Harmontide families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a bat builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /harmontide bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Apples, melon slices and sweet berries (+1), glow berries (+2)
  • Petting

What costs trust

  • Hitting her
  • Waking her

Devoted (60+)

Her pings never stop while you are near.

Mating & young

FormLive young. YoungPups, grown in 5 days. WhereBeside her. Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed.
2. YoungA day later she bears young.
3. GrowingHer young stay by their mother.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

RoostingBy day she hangs upside down under a ceiling (a cave roof, an overhang) and sleeps.
EcholocationBefriended, she pings every few seconds: monsters near her friend glow for a moment, through walls.
FlightShe flies, and never takes fall damage.

Species profiles

Caves & forestsNocturnal · keen-eared

Bat (about 1.4 blocks)

TemperamentShy by day, lively by night

Ecology & behaviourBats (Chiroptera), the only mammals that truly fly, who find their way in the dark by echolocation.

Signature: Roost and pingShe hangs upside down from ceilings to rest. Befriended, she pings every few seconds and monsters near her friend glow for a moment, through walls. The fruit bat has a fox face.

Player interactionFruit. Let her sleep.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Camazotz: at night, befriended, she bites a monster near her friend and the stolen strength heals them
  • Bat: flies; by day she hangs upside down under the nearest ceiling (a cave roof, an overhang) and sleeps
  • Echolocation: befriended, she pings every three seconds and the monsters within 16 blocks of her friend glow
  • Fruit (glow berries +2); gifts of guano (bone meal) and glow berries
  • Vanilla bats are her kin
  • The fruit bat variant has a fox's face
  • Vetala: befriended, she rides a zombie near her friend and it fights for them
  • Frondbat: befriended, every half minute she shakes the leaves near her friend: saplings, sticks and now and then an apple fall
  • Datebat: roosts by day; at night, befriended, the crops near her grow

Not yet

  • A vampire bat who drinks from sleeping mobs

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • One species first (2026-10-25), the fruit bat as a variant (a fox face). Vampires keep bats too.

Open questions

  • A vampire bat who drinks from sleeping mobs?
